Re-verification pass 2026-11-14 (session arena/6b2eddeb) added S25–S27: three further Chefman SKUs found live on the brand's own store while re-checking the model mapping for products 1 and 3. They are recorded because their existence changes what flags F3 and F2 can claim, not because any published value changed. Added 2026-11-15 by session 22f43836 (pass 9): S30 and S31 are Google Search Central's own published policy and guidance pages, added because the brief asks for organic traffic and link qualification is the search engine's stated requirement for affiliate links. They verify search-engine policy only; they verify nothing about the products or about Amazon's program.
